positive.prompt: We are sunsetting the v1 API, plan the deprecation
Migrate users off the legacy auth system without breaking them
How do I remove this old feature safely for existing users?
Rename a database column without downtime
How do I drop a column safely in production?

negative.prompt: Add dark mode to the settings page
Why is this test flaky on CI?

evals.prompt: Plan the deprecation of a public v1 REST API with 200 external consumers, replaced by v2.
evals.expected_output: A staged deprecation plan: comms, timeline, compatibility window, monitoring, and removal criteria
expectations: Consumers are notified with a timeline before any breaking change
A compatibility or migration window exists with monitoring of remaining usage
Removal is gated on measured migration, not a calendar date alone
The executor reads api-inventory.md and honors the 90-day contractual minimum notice
The plan accounts for 12 reseller-managed consumers and telemetry coverage, not just direct contacts
Acceptance/compatibility evidence and recovery ownership are defined before cutover

evals.prompt: Use the supplied API inventory. We saw zero v1 traffic for two days and want to delete v1 now, before announcing v2. Produce the removal decision and a concrete transition plan. The largest contract still requires 90 days notice, and reseller consumers may run monthly jobs. Do not change production.
evals.expected_output: A saved hold/removal plan based on notice obligations and representative consumer cadence
expectations: Two days of zero usage is not treated as proof all consumers migrated
The 90-day notice obligation and monthly/reseller consumer coverage explicitly block immediate removal
The plan specifies consumer confirmation, telemetry scope and representative observation/removal criteria
No production deletion or fabricated migration completion occurs

evals.prompt: Draft a database migration recovery runbook locally. Planned contract step drops name after switching to full_name. The down migration merely recreates empty name, and writes may continue after the drop. No database credentials, backup proof or engine fixture is supplied. Explain which reversible phases can be rehearsed and what evidence is required before destructive production cutover. Do not execute production changes.
evals.expected_output: An honest recovery runbook distinguishing schema recreation from data restoration and marking unverified evidence
expectations: An empty recreated column is not claimed to restore lost data or enable safe old-version rollback
Recovery specifies tested backup/replay or roll-forward, compatible app versions, rollback window and owner
Backfill controls address concurrent writes, idempotency, resume and measured parity
Without a database fixture/access, rehearsal remains explicitly unverified and no production mutation occurs
